name: menu_actions
description: Read the menu bar without opening it, fire entries by the name the source gives them, and watch the window change. A menu entry has no place on screen until its popup opens, so before Q-1b a scenario could not see one at all; menu_list is the listing and action is the gesture, and both stay out of the modal event loop a popup would start.
